title: Convert to mp4 but maintain quality

messages.content: convert to mp4 but maintain quality and resolution please

Same resolution, same quality — just a container swap. Video is already H.264 so I'll stream copy it (zero loss), and convert the PCM audio to high-bitrate AAC. Will be much smaller too since uncompressed audio is a space hog.Done — and it's already attached above. Here's the summary:

| | Before (.mov) | After (.mp4) |
|---|---|---|
| **Size** | 487 MB | **453 MB** |
| **Video** | H.264, 1920×1080, 24fps, ~39 Mbps | **Identical** (stream copy, 0 loss) |
| **Audio** | PCM 24-bit, 2.3 Mbps | **AAC 320 kbps** (transparent quality) |
| **Duration** | 1:33.75 | 1:33.75 |

Video is bit-for-bit identical. Audio went from uncompressed to high-bitrate AAC — indistinguishable to human ears. Shaved off ~34 MB from dropping the uncompressed PCM. 🐟
